case_id.meaning: AIJ UWE case letter, A to M

config.meaning: configuration within the case: 'default' (A, B, D, G to M, and Case F's 9 m tunnel plane, the benchmark plane); Case C centre building '0D' | '1D' | '2D'; Case E 'bc' (before construction) | 'ac' (after construction); Case F 'h5' | 'h20' (the tunnel's 5 m and 20 m planes above ground)

instrument.meaning: what measured the row. Tunnel: 'split_fibre' = hot-wire split-fibre probe, vector components (A, B, D, H, J, K, L, M); 'thermistor' = omnidirectional scalar speed (C, D, E, F); 'ldv' = laser Doppler anemometer, U V W k (I); 'hydrocarbon_analyser' = high-speed total hydrocarbon analyser, tracer concentration (H, I, M). Field (campaign 'field'): 'cup_anemometer' = cup anemometer, scalar speed ratio (F); 'sonic_anemometer' = three-dimensional ultrasonic anemometer, scalar speed ratio and k ratio (G); 'sorbent_gc_ecd' = sorbent tubes read by gas chromatography with an electron-capture detector, tracer concentration (M)

point_id.meaning: the tunnel's own measurement point number (No.); shared across configurations and directions of a case

wind_direction_deg.meaning: the case's wind direction label. A-D and G-L: the AIJ turntable angle WD (0 = +x; G to L have only 0). E and F: meteorological FROM-direction, clockwise from north (N = 0, E = 90). M: the FROM-direction in the case's frame (+x is north, so 180 blows toward +x), a field run's own mean direction at the reference point. The flow vector per direction is in directions.csv

wind_direction.meaning: compass name of the FROM-direction (Cases E and F; '' elsewhere)

x.meaning: case frame (SCHEMA.md): +x = streamwise at WD = 0 for A-D and H-L, downwind for G, east for E and F, north for M; model-scale metres for A-D and H-L, full-scale metres for E, F, G and M

y.meaning: case frame: +y lateral (A-D, H-L), along the tree belt (G), north (E, F), west (M)

z.meaning: height above the ground plane (the tunnel floor in Cases F and M: F's height above ground = z - 10 m, M's campus ground lies near z = 32 m)

V.meaning: mean velocity component along +y (positive toward +y in EVERY case; the published sign is flipped in Case B and for points 1-220 of Case H, see manifest transform)

uu.meaning: variance of the x-component fluctuation <u'u'> (Case A publishes rms; squared here)

k.meaning: turbulent kinetic energy as published (= (uu+vv+ww)/2 wherever all three variances exist; checked)

Vs.meaning: mean omnidirectional SCALAR wind speed from a thermistor anemometer. NOT |mean velocity vector| (Case D's split-fibre |U| column is dropped, see log)

velocity_ratio.meaning: mean speed over the case's reference speed. E: Vs / U_ref, U_ref = the approach-flow speed at z = 15.9 m (full scale). F: U / U_ref, U_ref = the approaching mean wind speed at 500 m (full scale; field values converted to it by the tunnel). G: U / UH, UH = the mean speed at the tree height (7 m) during each measurement period. See manifest cases.<id>.normalisation; the other cases carry m/s instead

campaign.meaning: 'wind_tunnel' (model scale) or 'field' (a full-scale observation: Cases F, G, M)

run.meaning: replicate label within a campaign where the dataset publishes individual runs (Case M); empty elsewhere

C.meaning: mean tracer-gas concentration as published (volume fraction x 1e6 of the released gas diluted in air; Case M's field runs are published in ppq and converted x 1e-9)

concentration_ratio.meaning: C / c0, c0 = q / (U_ref L_ref^2) as the benchmark defines it for the case (manifest cases.<id>.normalisation)

T.meaning: mean air temperature as published (Cases J, L)

velocity_ratio_sd.meaning: standard deviation of velocity_ratio over the observations behind a field value (Case F)

k_ratio.meaning: k / U_ref^2 where the dataset publishes only normalised values (Case G; U_ref = U at the tree height)

case_id.meaning: AIJ UWE case letter, A to M

z.meaning: height above ground (model-scale metres A-D and H-L, full-scale metres E, F, G and M)

U.meaning: mean streamwise velocity. EXCEPT Case G, whose approach-flow table publishes U/Ub (Ub = U at 9 m, not published in m/s) and is carried as published: dimensionless there

uu.meaning: variance of the x-component fluctuation <u'u'> (Case A publishes rms; squared here)

k.meaning: turbulent kinetic energy. EXCEPT Case G: k/Ub^2, dimensionless

flow_dir_x.meaning: x-component of the unit vector the mean wind BLOWS TOWARD, in the case frame

flow_dir_y.meaning: y-component of the same unit vector

rows.meaning: rows of points.csv in this (config, direction, instrument)

measured.meaning: of those, rows whose measured quantity is not NaN

sense_basis.meaning: what fixes the rotation sense of this direction (measured from the data / read from a figure / definition)

note: column headers in every CSV are bare names; this file is the units sidecar; the parquet files carry the same map in their schema metadata
